generator: G = Hc + thetaK Khat + thetaM Mhat
bounds: gamma and each shell in [-2pi, 2pi], thetaK and thetaM in [-5, 5]. Box constraints only. Gamma and theta are not wrapped and have no assumed period.
rng: numpy Generator, seed = 20261107 + 1000*L + arm_index. arm_index plain=0, transfer=1, chebyshev=2.

interpolation.interior: linear if the source schedule has fewer than 3 layers, otherwise a natural cubic spline
interpolation.endpoints: constant extrapolation: a query outside the source knot interval takes the nearest endpoint value
interpolation.not_used: The index formula c'_l = ((l-1)/L) c_{l-1} + ((L-l+1)/L) c_l is not used. It refers to a source sample that does not exist.

shell_unwrap_period: pi, and only after a numerical global-phase check. Applied to c1, c2, c3 before resampling. Not applied to gamma or theta.
arm_plain: Ascending from this arm's own previous best. Resample that shell schedule onto the new layer centers. At L>=3 also keep a linear-only resample as a second seed. At L=2 also keep one Pagano shift, second-layer c1 minus 0.2*B. Remaining starts are N(0, 0.35) inside the box. No zero-padding of a new shell. No round-3 angle is a seed.
arm_transfer: Seeds are resampled from stored round-3 energy-optimal angles at L-1 and L+1 only, L+1 at most 6. One exact resample per available neighbor, then the remaining starts split equally between sigma 0.02 and sigma 0.1, round-robin over the neighbors. Perturbations are added to the full parameter vector. The stored L=6 point is never copied onto an L=6 start.
arm_chebyshev: x_l=(l-0.5)/L, c_lk = sum_{d=0}^{D} a_kd T_d(2 x_l - 1). First D=min(1, L-1), then D=min(3, L-1) if that degree is larger. Coefficient count 3*(D+1)+3. Then every coordinate of the legal 3L+3 vector is released. Final smoothness is not constrained. Each start is one pretrain chain plus one release.

ledgers.marginal: evaluations performed in this round, including failed starts and Chebyshev pretraining
ledgers.inclusive_plain_and_chebyshev: equal to marginal; they do not consume a stored seed
ledgers.inclusive_transfer: marginal plus the sum of round-3 A_sub_M nfev from L=1 through the highest neighboring depth used. Ancestor depths are not double-counted. This is source work, not a fresh discovery.

equal_budget: Same start count and the same full-parameter maxfun on every arm. Pretraining and stored-source evaluations are extra and are counted on the ledger named above. They are not free seeds.

4.note: exact round-3 QAOA p=8 best, read from that cell before this round's training

stronger_qaoa_reference_not_a_new_rescue.pareto_elimination_bar: A new matched QAOA state eliminates the previous L6 lead only if that same state has error <= 0.292 and F >= 0.610. The stored p=12 state does not.

success_definition: Energy-only success is error <= tau. Joint success is error <= tau and F >= F_baseline on that same start. Energy-only success is an optimizer diagnostic, not a seal. If the success count is zero, evals-per-success is censored and is not computed by division.
screening_not_a_proof: A useful finite-budget screen is p_success at least 0.25 above plain and evals-per-success at most half of plain, on the inclusive ledger, at L5 and L6. Missing it is not a certainty claim and not a proof that only one point exists.
basins: Cluster by |<psi_i|psi_j>| > 0.99. Do not merge a state with a complex conjugate unless that direct overlap itself passes. Count conjugate-only pairs separately.
